title: Resolution to set final property tax class shares for 2027
summary: This resolution certifies the Adjusted Base Proportions, which set the final share of the property tax levy paid by each of the City's four property tax classes for fiscal year 2027 (July 2026 through June 2027). It updates earlier certified figures based on the final assessment roll released by the Department of Finance on May 26, 2026, reflecting changes from construction, demolition and other property changes. Under the new figures Class 1 and Class 2 shares decrease slightly while Class 3 and Class 4 shares increase.
